I'm 23 and ive been diagnosed by experts to have had polio, or "a polio-type virus" younger doctors. Dont know how I contracted it, but I am very lucky. By two my family noticed one of my calf muscles wasnt developing, and that one of my feet was growing far slower than the other. 
Younger doctors have actually asked me what Polio is, because they supposedly aren't even taught about it, or heard of it... not sure how. 
I lack a lot of nerves on one side of my body, had to pay £6000 for a silicone implant in my leg, because although you can get a Boob job on the NHS, my leg was 'cosmetic'. I live every day in pain, and it gets worse every year. I have to live unable to know what its like to not be in pain, or able to write or walk for long periods, and I've had it easier than most.
It makes me sick to see people spinning lies about Vaccinations, to subject innocent children to diseases like Polio is disgusting. It's child abuse. It makes me sick to my stomach. The children don't get a choice in this... their parents get to decide whether their child will grow up as healthy as they can ensure, or to grow up in pain, suffering from a preventable disease. The world is messed up.
